ArtemisOS 1.0.6 — independent display runtime
==========================================

ArtemisOS launches the unmodified scrcpy 4.1 Windows x64 client as a separate
process. Branding is supplied as a separate PNG. Original scrcpy LICENSE.txt
is retained beside the executable. Copyrights remain with their owners;
no endorsement of ArtemisOS is claimed.

Components and full accompanying license texts:
* scrcpy 4.1 client, Android server and original artwork: Genymobile and
  contributors; Apache-2.0, scrcpy-LICENSE.txt.
* SDL 3.4.12: Sam Lantinga and contributors; zlib, SDL-LICENSE.txt.
  Bundled HIDAPI uses the BSD alternative (SDL-hidapi-LICENSE-bsd.txt);
  original license/choice notices are also retained. Bundled yuv2rgb's
  permission/copyright notice is in SDL-yuv2rgb-LICENSE.
* FFmpeg 8.1.2 (avcodec-62, avformat-62, avutil-60, swresample-6):
  FFmpeg developers; LGPL-2.1-or-later, FFmpeg-COPYING.LGPLv2.1 and
  FFmpeg-LICENSE.md. Actual configuration is recorded in
  evidence/observed-ffmpeg-build.txt: shared DLLs, no enable-gpl/nonfree,
  with libdav1d and zlib enabled.
* libusb 1.0.30: libusb contributors; LGPL-2.1-or-later, libusb-COPYING.
* dav1d 1.5.3, statically included by FFmpeg: VideoLAN/dav1d authors;
  BSD-2-Clause, dav1d-COPYING.
* zlib 1.3.1, statically included by FFmpeg: Jean-loup Gailly/Mark Adler;
  zlib-LICENSE. Actual DLLs contain the inflate 1.3.1 identifier.
* MinGW-w64 runtime: full original copyright/permission notices are in
  MinGW-w64-runtime-COPYING.txt, MinGW-w64-COPYING, MinGW-w64-DISCLAIMER,
  MinGW-w64-DISCLAIMER.PD and MinGW-w64-AUTHORS. Additional toolchain
  notices are in MinGW-w64-notices.txt.
* GCC 13 runtime support: GPLv3 with GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1;
  GCC-COPYING3 and GCC-COPYING.RUNTIME. Compiler executables are not bundled.

Corresponding sources and replacement rights
--------------------------------------------
Complete display sources, original build recipes and checksums are offered
from the same public download location as the installer and OTA:
https://cloudx.playones.com/d/CLOUD/Footage/EAPIL/Artemis/ota/sources/ArtemisOS15-Display-Sources-1.0.6.zip

Relative to update/server.txt: sources/ArtemisOS15-Display-Sources-1.0.6.zip
(preserve OpenList's ?d query). sources.json records its size and SHA-256.
This uses LGPL 2.1 sections 4 and 6(d)'s equivalent-access route: downloading
source is optional, but the publisher must upload and retain equivalent
public access before distributing the binaries. Upstream links alone do not
replace the accompanying complete source package.

Users may copy, modify and redistribute LGPL libraries under their terms.
Compatible modified DLLs can replace those beside runtime/scrcpy.exe.
Reverse engineering for debugging modifications to these libraries is
permitted; ArtemisOS adds no restriction overriding that permission.
The complete Apache-licensed scrcpy client and all LGPL sources/build recipes
are offered, permitting rebuilding/relinking the display program. The native
ArtemisOS shell communicates using processes, ADB and window management;
it does not link these LGPL DLLs. Preparation hashes document the release;
they are not runtime integrity restrictions on users' replacement DLLs.

The complete licenses and warranty disclaimers are retained without truncation.
FFmpeg-permissive-notices.txt and SDL-permissive-notices.txt additionally retain
original BSD/MIT-style source comment notices, including uncompiled code.
See BUILDING.md for evidence, source contents and reproducibility limitations.
